definitions.explanation: The title or status of being champion in a sport or competition, or the tournament or competition held to determine a champion.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{選手権|せんしゅけん}が{来月|らいげつ}{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The world championship will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{全国|ぜんこく}{選手権|せんしゅけん}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
このチームは{三年|さんねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{選手権|せんしゅけん}の{決勝|けっしょう}に{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: This team has advanced to the championship finals for three consecutive years.

notes:
A compound of {選手|せんしゅ} (athlete, player) and {権|けん} (right, title). Literally "the right/title of being the selected player," meaning the championship title.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界|せかい}{選手権|せんしゅけん} (world championship)
- {全国|ぜんこく}{選手権|せんしゅけん} (national championship)
- {選手権|せんしゅけん}{大会|たいかい} (championship tournament)
- {選手権|せんしゅけん}を{獲得|かくとく}する (to win the championship)
- {選手権|せんしゅけん}を{防衛|ぼうえい}する (to defend the championship)

Very commonly seen in sports news. Can refer to both the title itself and the tournament held to determine the champion. Often appears with a scope prefix like {世界|せかい} (world) or {全国|ぜんこく} (national).
